div.div: خُزَزٌ The male of the أَرْنَب [or hare]: (S, A, Msb, K:) or the offspring of the ارنب: (TA:) pl. [of pauc.] أَخِزَّةٌ (K) and [of mult.] خِزَّانٌ. (S, Msb, K.) Hence the saying, مَسُّهُ مَسُّ الخُزَزِ [The feel of him, or it, is like the feel of the male, or young, hare]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
